name: edgemirror-monorepo
description: EdgeMirror monorepo — production parity testing for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @edgemirror/organizations && npm run build -w @edgemirror/billing && npm run build -w @edgemirror/api && npm run build -w @edgemirror/cli && npm run build -w @edgemirror/vitest && npm run build -w @edgemirror/ui
scripts.test: npm run test:billing && npm run test -w @edgemirror/cli
scripts.test:billing: npm run build -w @edgemirror/organizations && npm run build -w @edgemirror/billing && npm run test -w @edgemirror/organizations && npm run test -w @edgemirror/billing && npm run test -w @edgemirror/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/organizations && npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/billing && npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/api && npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/cli && npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/vitest && npm run typecheck -w @edgemirror/ui
scripts.ci:local: npm run check:versions && npm run check:changelog && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm test && npm run gate:security && npm run build && npm run validate:docs && npm run test:e2e
